# David Raigoza

> One-partner, zero-handoffs product design and engineering studio. David Raigoza helps founders and product teams turn ideas into production-ready products by combining product strategy, design, engineering, and AI workflows into one continuous partnership. Based in Medellín, Colombia; works internationally.

David is a solo product designer and full-stack engineer with 15 years of experience across product design, brand strategy, Web3/DeFi development, smart contract security auditing, and digital marketing. He designs and builds the software himself, with no handoff to a separate development team.

## Work With Me

- [Work With Me](https://davidraigoza.design/work-with-me): Services, engagement models, pricing, and process.
- Services: Discovery & Product Strategy, Product Design, Product Engineering, AI Workflow Design, Web3 Product Development.
- Engagement models: Discovery Sprint (starting at $2,500), MVP Partnership (starting at $10,000), Fractional Product Partner (custom monthly engagement).
- Process: Understand → Model → Design → Build → Deploy → Learn.
- Best fit for: teams validating a new product, teams needing both strategy and execution, AI product builders, Web3 product builders, teams wanting one technical partner.
- Not the best fit for: buyers looking for the cheapest freelancer, teams needing a large production agency, teams with a finished spec needing only implementation, high-volume marketing production.
- [Book a Discovery Call](https://cal.com/davidraigoza)

## Selected Work

- [Virtual Portfolio Hub](https://aistudio.google.com/apps/a6a43dcb-0f83-4b02-aed2-169360546c3a?fullscreenApplet=true): Conversational AI portfolio platform with dynamic project filtering, built during an AI bootcamp competition.
- [SiftParity (ApplyIQ)](https://applyiq-job-scanner.vercel.app/): Enterprise tracking platform migrated from Airtable to Supabase with sub-100ms real-time telemetry.
- [QIE Neobank](https://davidraigoza.design/work/qie-neobank): Full-stack DeFi ecosystem abstracting protocol friction; shortlisted from 411 global submissions.
- [Bruma Protocol](https://bruma-protocol.vercel.app/): Smart-contract telemetry paired with AI-generated risk narratives for volatile settlement windows.
- [GitHub Core](https://github.com/NinjaPuppetDev): Open smart contracts, protocol interfaces, and telemetry systems.
- [Pepe Matilda](https://davidraigoza.design/work/pepe-matilda): Silver jewelry brand David founded; e-commerce design awarded Colombia's Lápiz de Acero (2013).
- [NextStep](https://davidraigoza.design/work/next-step): Parametric visual configuration flow for a custom 3D-printed footwear brand.
- [Marigold Bloom](https://davidraigoza.design/work/marigold-bloom): Omnichannel identity and ritual-driven digital interface for a clean cosmetics brand.

## Products in Development

- Vera: AI interface for navigating products and portfolios.
- Common Ground: Ontology-based market positioning analysis tool.
- Web3 Builder: AI-assisted Web3 application builder with automated deployment and testing.
